decisions.structure: NativeRuntimePolicy.CpuFeatureDetectionFunction owns the exact CPU detect LLVM definition; generator projects it into existing llvm.runtime module. Both emitters call that definition at the existing AES runtime publication point.
decisions.branches: cached versus detect; SSE2 and AES CPUID bits; atomic cmpxchg winner versus previously published value; cached ready return
decisions.logic: Exact24-line original CSharp definition equals existing SLG24-line definition. Extraction changes the authority only. No hardware detection, specialization admission, ABI, allocation or ciphertext behavior is changed.
decisions.diagnostics: Current CSharp AES known-vector and AES/GCM cases3/3 pass. Existing case source and stdout oracles are unchanged. LLVM definition inspection is a declared pending consumer before artifact cleanup.

originalBody: %cached = load atomic i64, ptr @sollang_cpu_features monotonic, align 8
%leaf1 = call { i32, i32, i32, i32 } asm "xchgq %rbx, ${1:q}\0Acpuid\0Axchgq %rbx, ${1:q}", "={ax},=r,={cx},={dx},0,2"(i32 1, i32 0)
%installed = cmpxchg ptr @sollang_cpu_features, i64 -1, i64 %detected monotonic monotonic

sourceEmitterBudget.reason: One current CLI after CSharp3, exact source-definition comparison, semantic4 and stdlib1; no exhaustive or Stage build.
